Ivan, stand further back, over there behind the pines.

words.gloss: to stand up, to get up

lines.trans: Danya, is this your sharpener? And your axe?
Yes, my axe. Wow! How did you do that?
Just like that, Danya! A meter fifty off the ground!
You can buy anything at all!
But you can't buy skill, got it?
We're strictly forbidden to show this. But you're family!
And there's also close combat! Watch what I can do!

words.gloss: to know how to, to be able to

lines.trans: Easy, Vanya, be careful! Why are you kicking the tree with your foot?
It's fine, don't be afraid! Can you do that, Danya, or not?
No, I can't do that. You kicked higher than me.
And right now I'll kick even higher! Watch, everyone!
Ow, my hand! The axe fell onto my hand!
Samsonov, have you lost your mind?! Quickly to the hospital!

the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: Stand a little further back behind the pines.

examples.text: Его весь день показывают по телевизору.

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it
